runs.prompt: What would adding one instance to app-a cost over a full monthly plan period?

result.provenance: Synthetic replay of public official pricing; not a live lookup.

runs.response: For app-a's apps-s-1vcpu-1gb plan, the supplied public pricing fixture is USD 12 per instance per full monthly plan period, attributed to [DigitalOcean App Platform pricing](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/app-platform/details/pricing/) on 2026-10-01; this walkthrough replays that source rather than performing a live lookup. Calculated baseline compute cost: 1 × USD 12 = USD 12. Calculated proposed compute cost: 2 × USD 12 = USD 24. Calculated increment: USD 24 − USD 12 = USD 12. Full-period runtime is an assumption, so these are projected compute charges, not an invoice. Plan, storage and traffic are assumed unchanged; usage-dependent egress and storage charges, taxes and credits are excluded where unknown. The Known USD 40 August 2026 invoice is a separate historical total and is not added to the projection. This comparison does not establish capacity suitability and no configuration was changed.

rubric.expectation: Calculate baseline USD 12, proposed USD 24 and incremental USD 12 for one versus two instances over the same period.
rubric.reason: The same rate and period yield baseline 12, proposed 24 and increment 12 with explicit arithmetic.

rubric.expectation: Cite the supplied official pricing source/date and label full-period runtime as an assumption, not an observed invoice.
rubric.reason: Source, fixture date and replay provenance are disclosed; runtime and projected charges are separate from invoices.

rubric.expectation: Keep the USD 40 historical invoice separate, disclose usage/tax/credit exclusions and make no configuration changes.
rubric.reason: The invoice is kept separate, assumptions/exclusions are stated, and no simulated writes are recorded.
